data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 食堂花束里的花嫁定食
data.description: 【学校礼堂小食堂·午后】杏菜穿着清爽的蓝白婚纱坐在长桌边，捧花里偷偷插着一枚苹果糖；她先确认仪式菜单够不够丰盛，再对镜头举起苹果糖，笑得像终于等到一场不会落空的约会。
data.location: small school dining hall dressed for a ceremony
data.action: 长桌边先核对庆典菜单再举起花束中的苹果糖，笑得像等到不会落空的约会
data.lighting: warm afternoon light over blue-white decorations
data.mood: 把失恋体质暂时换成花嫁满足感
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami sits beside the long table in the school hall's small dining area, checking the ceremony menu before lifting the candy apple hidden in her bouquet toward the viewer. Her blue-and-white wedding dress, ribbon sash and short veil remain fresh and tidy. The vertical medium-full view includes the table settings and blue-white decorations behind. Warm afternoon light reveals the apple glaze and gown folds, with gentle paper shadows across the menu.
